premises: AlCoCrFeNi2.1 EHEA has a lamellar FCC/B2 microstructure in the as-cast state
Thermo-mechanical processing can refine this lamellar structure into an ultrafine-grained duplex microstructure
The refined heterogeneous structure induces a two-hierarchical constraint effect and microcrack-arresting mechanism
This mechanism simultaneously increases strength and ductility relative to the as-cast state
Specific processing (cold-rolling + annealing) has already achieved strength up to 1.2 GPa with ~12% elongation
